description: This file implements server-side logic for the Opportunities List page in a CRM application. It handles data loading, filtering, pagination, and CRUD operations for opportunities, as well as managing line items and creating invoices through API requests to a Django backend.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches opportunities, related data, and options from the Django API, processes, and returns them for rendering.

methods.name: actions.create
methods.description: Creates a new opportunity with data from the form, via API.

methods.name: actions.update
methods.description: Updates an existing opportunity with form data via API.

methods.name: actions.updateStage
methods.description: Updates only the stage of a specific opportunity.

methods.name: actions.delete
methods.description: Deletes an opportunity specified by ID.

methods.name: actions.addLineItem
methods.description: Adds a product (line item) to an opportunity.

methods.name: actions.updateLineItem
methods.description: Updates details of a specific line item within an opportunity.

methods.name: actions.deleteLineItem
methods.description: Removes a line item from an opportunity.

methods.name: actions.createInvoice
methods.description: Creates an invoice from an opportunity.
